purpose: Provide Core 1.4 a stable, auditable Billy Walters handicapping interface whose authority can be switched OFF, ADVISORY or BET_AUTHORITY at runtime.

authorityControl.rule: Core 1.4 resolves the current Walters authority mode before handicapping each eligible candidate/report. A mode change applies forward only and never rewrites issued history.

sourceAuthority.primaryMethodSource: Billy Walters, Gambler, Chapters 21 and 22, using approved structured summaries and user-supplied source material rather than repository-stored unauthorized full chapter text
sourceAuthority.page270Rule: Spread-versus-moneyline conversion must use the corrected, internally reconciled source logic. If the approved correction cannot be resolved, return SPREAD_VS_ML_UNAVAILABLE rather than infer from an inconsistent historical chart.

coverage.futureExpansion: Other sports/markets may use the interface only after their Walters methodology mapping is explicitly defined and tested.
coverage.meaning: When Walters mode is not OFF, Core 1.4 must resolve whether Walters intelligence is AVAILABLE, PARTIAL or UNAVAILABLE for an eligible market. Missing Walters data does not block an otherwise valid Betting Edge report.

source.sourceAsOf: timestamp/date through which Walters inputs are current
source.sourceRefs: array of provenance references for power ratings, personnel, game factors and any conversion tables used

power.rawHomeDifferential: number|null; home rating minus away rating

personnel.unresolved: array of material unresolved player/position-group questions

fairSpread.homePerspective: number|null; negative means home favorite, positive means home underdog
fairSpread.componentEquation: human-readable rating + home field + personnel + factors path

proposedWager.edgeRationale: why Walters views the exact wager as actionable|null

keyNumbers.crossings: array of material NFL key-number crossings between Walters fair and market reference
keyNumbers.tableRef: provenance reference to the current calibrated key-number table when used

spreadVsMoneyline.logicRef: provenance reference to corrected conversion logic

marketReference.rule: Comparison context only. Executable identity/price/freshness comes from the normal Betting Edge feed and hard gates.

coreComparison.materialityRationale: why agreement/disagreement is or is not material, including key-number context

BET_AUTHORITY.eligibilityRule: Only a complete/current/arithmetic-verified Walters build satisfying the authority configuration may originate BET. The resulting wager must still pass normal Core 1.4 model-error, identity, freshness, personnel, price-quality, exposure and staking rules.

runtimeAuthorityBoundary.rule: BET_AUTHORITY can originate a BET and contribute a fair-value input, but it cannot bypass Betting Edge hard gates. Switching back to ADVISORY or OFF removes that authority on future reports without changing the Core 1.4 version.
